articles.author: Violet Jira
articles.title: Takeaways from JD Vance’s town hall forum in Michigan - The Washington Post
articles.description: A fallen soldier's husband asked Vance about ‘mistakes’ and ‘failures’ in Iran war. Gas prices and immigration were also key topics in event hosted by CBS.
articles.content: Vice President JD Vance faced questions from Michigan voters on affordability, the war in Iran and other issues that will decide the midterm elections during a town hall hosted by CBS News on Saturda… [+1 chars]
